tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "B5A8047F436DD1629C140D91E3BF06C1", "Select an item from the list to add it to your cart. Once you\'ve selected the quantity of items you\'d like to buy, use the Purchase button to complete your transaction. ")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "00C332FC465CD37D3B53DBB86358DB66", "Items can be sold to the vendor by selecting them from your Inventory window. There\'s no buy-back, so be careful! ")
